Title: Implement Fight Simulator
Description: Logic-only simulation to run many battle iterations for balancing.
Personal_Notes: Uses same rules engine as battle scene.

Title: Create Boss Scripting Framework
Description: Boss phase logic, abilities, targeting, and phase transitions.
Personal_Notes: Matches your weekly boss design rules.

Title: Create Abilities Popup
Description: Shows all player abilities, cooldowns, descriptions, and related stats.

Title: Create Research Popup
Description: Research UI with selectable research opportunities (i.e. dungeons, artifacts, bosses, Paimon's Corner for advice, etc.) and have a panel where they can type out their notes and briefly show them a snippet related to that opportunity on a timer. When the timer runs out the research panel closes and copies everything they typed to their keyboard. Once they have researched once in the player hub the button becomes locked until they go into combat.

Title: Create Stats Popup
Description: Build stats popup UI pulling from FINAL_CHARACTER_STATS with live dice mapping per rules. Should have a relevant breakdown for how it came to that total current stat number. I.e. how many points of that stat came from skill points, base points, there weapon, artifacts, effects, etc. This also needs a nob for both skill and base points and any time those values aren't 0 those nobs need to be unlocked with a confirm button that allows them to set those skill points into that stat.
Personal_Notes: Should mirror current stat calculation in Global.

Title: Create Market Popup
Description: Implement market UI with item listing, buy/sell functions, and price handling. Needs stores that sell different products, each store only sells a certain type. Generally has all the items of that type that can be found in that region. May have items of that type from other regions but sold at a pretty high markup and isn't guaranteed to have those items.

Title: Create Gather Popup
Description: Gather UI allowing players to collect resources, uses a D4 to determine which resource cache they are collecting from, and a D12 to determine how much of each resource from that cache they get. Some players have the ability to choose a specific material to gather, if they do it just uses that cache and they skip the D4 roll. Once they have gathered once in a Player Hub that button becomes locked until they go into combat.
Personal_Notes: May tie into world state tracking.

Title: Create Inventory Popup
Description: Inventory display with item categories, filtering, and which recipes those items may be used in. Need to assign a value to each item in the database as well.

Title: Create Constellations Popup
Description: UI to show constellation levels and their effects; allow unlocking via resources.
Personal_Notes: Needs link to character progression system.

Title: Create Crafting Popup
Description: Crafting UI with recipe selection, input slots, output preview, and craft button. Needs a preview that shows how many of that item they can craft. Figure out how to do crafting with items that could take one of many different variations as an input (i.e. maybe a recipe requires a 1 star elemental gem but it can be of any element).

Title: Create Talents Popup
Description: Talent tree UI with unlockable nodes and effects display.
Personal_Notes: May share layout logic with Constellations.

Title: Create Ascend Popup
Description: Popup to handle ascension requirements, display bonuses, and perform ascension.

Title: Create Character Profile Popup
Description: Shows portrait, lore, base stats, and equipped gear for the character.

Title: Build Battle Scene MVP
Description: Battle scene with turn order UI, enemy stats display, action selection, and logging.

Title: Build DM Hub MVP
Description: DM-only hub to manage player states, items, encounters, and triggers.

Title: Secure NocoDB Access
